verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents a CLI and an official MCP server that let external tools/agents read and manipulate collections, requests, environments, and send real HTTP requests, which gives AI-native users programmatic access points (hoppscotch-docs-8, -21, -22, -32, probe-3, probe-4). However, there is no evidence of a traditional documented public REST/OpenAPI API for the platform itself — probes for openapi.json/swagger endpoints all returned 404 (hoppscotch-probe-2), so full programmatic API access beyond the CLI/MCP surface is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API (OpenAPI/REST) beyond CLI and MCP, and independent hands-on confirmation that these interfaces are robust for agentic driving.
